evals.prompt: Run a full EDA on evals/files/train.csv with target column 'target'. Identify any data quality issues.
evals.expected_output: EDA report with shape, missing value counts, numeric/categorical summaries, high correlations, target distribution, and any data quality flags.
assertions: Output includes task type (Classification or Regression)

evals.prompt: Clean evals/files/train.csv and save to /tmp/clean_output.csv. Report all changes made.
evals.expected_output: Cleaned CSV file with a JSON report listing: duplicates removed, types fixed, missing values handled. Input row count preserved or reduced with explanation.
assertions: Output CSV exists at specified path

evals.prompt: Engineer features from evals/files/train.csv targeting the 'target' column. Apply numeric scaling and encode categorical columns.
evals.expected_output: CSV with additional engineered features. Log-transformed numeric columns, encoded categoricals, interaction features. Output has more columns than input.
assertions: Output has more columns than input
